external_audience.proposition: The document is written for, or about to be shared with, readers outside the institution: a partner government, the press, or the public.

public_audience.proposition: The document is written for, or about to be shared with, the press or the general public.

restricted.proposition: Disclosing the document outside the institution could endanger people or compromise security or a negotiation.

staff_movements.proposition: The document discloses travel itineraries, accommodation, routes, or security arrangements for named staff or delegations.

negotiating_position.proposition: The document states the institution's negotiating position, red lines, or fallback terms.

personal_data.proposition: The document contains personal data about an identifiable individual, such as a personal phone number, home address, passport or ID number, or health information.

security_incident.proposition: The document reports a security, safety, or data-breach incident.

financial_commitment.proposition: The document commits the institution to spend, transfer, or guarantee funds.

legal_exposure.proposition: The document mentions litigation, sanctions, export controls, or a regulatory investigation involving the institution.

foreign_official_named.proposition: The document names a specific official of a foreign or host government.

release_requested.proposition: The document asks for itself or its contents to be shared outside the institution.

rules.title: Staff movements leaving the institution
rules.rationale: Itineraries and security arrangements for staff are never shared outside the institution.

rules.title: Release request for restricted material
rules.rationale: Restricted material needs declassification by the records officer before any release.

rules.title: Negotiating position leaving the institution
rules.rationale: Red lines and fallback terms shared outside the institution weaken the negotiation.

rules.title: Personal data leaving the institution
rules.rationale: The privacy office checks the legal basis for any external transfer of personal data.

rules.title: Security or safety incident
rules.rationale: Every incident report goes to the security desk, wherever it was filed.

rules.title: Financial commitment
rules.rationale: Commitments of funds need a delegated finance approver.

rules.title: Legal or regulatory exposure
rules.rationale: Counsel reviews anything touching litigation, sanctions, or export controls.

rules.title: Foreign official named in a public release
rules.rationale: Protocol confirms titles and consent before a foreign official is named publicly.
